newsitem.title: USA: Enron tumbles on profit outlook.
newsitem.headline: Enron tumbles on profit outlook.

text.p: Shares of Enron Corp tumbled 2-1/8 to 38-1/2 after the company cut its forecast for 1997 earnings by $0.30 per share to approximately $2.25 on a primary earnings per share basis.
PaineWebber earlier cut its rating on the stock to neutral from attractive after the announcement.

PaineWebber analyst Ron Barone said that he had reduced his 1997 earnings per share estimate to $2.25 from $2.50 to reflect higher than expected interest costs -- around $0.10 according to Enron -- as a result of the settlement of a take or pay natural gas dispute with energy producers on the UK J-Block field, a lower than expected contribution from EOTT Energy Corp and lower than expected contributions from asset sales.
He has cut his 1998 EPS estimate to $2.50 from $2.80.
Barone said however that any severe weakness in the stock would be used to upgrade it, given strong longer-term fundamentals. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
